how.heading: No risk. Here's how it works.

step1.title: Tell us about your business
step1.body: A ten-minute conversation. What you do, who your customers are, what the site should achieve.

step2.title: We build your homepage. Free.
step2.body: Within three days you get a real, working page. Not a mockup. Your actual business on a real site you can open on your phone.

step3.title: You decide
step3.body: Like it? We build the rest and you pay then. Don't like it? Walk away. No invoice, no obligation.

how.fineprint: The free draft covers your homepage with one round of revisions.

why.heading: You already get customers through recommendations. Here's what a website adds.
why.intro: Nobody in Baku finds their dentist through Google. But something happens between the recommendation and the phone call — and that's where a website earns its cost.

p1.title: The recommendation gets you halfway, your site closes it
p1.body: Someone tells a friend about you, that friend searches before calling. What they find in 30 seconds decides whether you get the call. A professional site turns those 30 seconds in your favor.

p2.title: Your Instagram isn't actually yours
p2.body: Accounts get hacked, restricted, lost. When Meta changes an algorithm, your reach changes too. A website is the only thing you truly own online, and nobody can take it from you.

p3.title: Stop answering the same question 50 times a month
p3.body: When services, prices, and hours are on your site, customers arrive already informed. Conversations get shorter, closer to closing, and you spend time on actual work.

p4.title: You look like a company, not a phone number
p4.body: For corporate clients, suppliers, partners, and tenders, a website is the minimum requirement. A business without a site isn't taken seriously, that's just the reality.

pricing.heading: What it costs
pricing.sub: Published prices. No "contact us for a quote."

team.heading: Who's behind it
team.body1: We started building websites for friends and local businesses, and kept going because we saw the same gap everywhere: businesses either overpaid an agency for a slow template, or hired a freelancer who disappeared halfway through.
team.body2: We use AI to handle the repetitive parts of writing code. That's how we cut delivery times and can afford to build your homepage before you've paid anything. The design decisions and the thinking about what your customers actually need — that's us.

contact.heading: Let's start with the free draft
contact.body: Send a message and tell us what your business does. We reply within a few hours.

estimator.disclaimer: One-time price covers site setup. Monthly services are optional and can be cancelled anytime.

meta.title: About | Tezsayt.dev
meta.desc: Two computer science students building websites for businesses in Azerbaijan.

about.heading: Two people. No account managers.
about.intro: We're building websites for Azerbaijani businesses because we kept seeing the same problem and thought it could be solved better.

story.heading: How this started
story.body1: We met while building software projects together. Real problems, tight deadlines. Then friends started asking us to build websites for their businesses, and we noticed something.
story.body2: Every business owner we spoke to had the same two options. Pay an agency two thousand manat and wait two months for a template. Or hire a freelancer for four hundred and hope they finish. Neither is good, and both ask you to pay before you've seen anything.
story.body3: So we changed the order. We build your homepage first, you look at it, and then you decide. It only works because we're fast enough to afford it.

why.heading: Why AI-assisted
why.body: Not because it's fashionable. Because it means a high-quality site takes days instead of weeks, and we can pass that saving on. AI handles the repetitive code. We handle the design thinking, the structure, the business logic, and the decisions about what your customers actually need. You get both speed and quality — that's the entire point.

1.title: Transparent pricing
1.body: You know the exact number before work begins. No hidden costs, surprise invoices, or add-on fees after the project starts. The agreed price is the final price.

2.title: Fast delivery
2.body: We automate repetitive tasks with AI, cutting timelines without cutting quality. Each project type has its own timeline — see the services page.

3.title: Full ownership
3.body: Code, domain, and all data are registered in your name from day one. You can work with another team anytime — nothing is locked to us.

4.title: Local understanding
4.body: We know how business works in Azerbaijan, what your customers expect, and the specifics of the local market. Your site is built for the people here.

catch.q: What's the catch with the free draft?
catch.a: There isn't one. We build your homepage because it's the fastest way to show you what we can do — faster than a portfolio, faster than a sales call. Most people who see their own business on a real page want the rest built. Some don't, and that's fine. We'd rather spend three days proving it than three days arguing about it.

fast.q: How can you be this fast?
fast.a: AI handles the repetitive parts of writing code — the work that used to take days of typing. That leaves us to focus on design, structure, and making it work for your specific business. The quality doesn't drop. The timeline does.

own.q: Do I actually own everything afterwards?
own.a: Yes. Your domain is registered in your name from day one, the code is handed over to you, and the hosting account is yours. If you decide to work with someone else next year, you take everything with you. Nothing is locked to us.

changes.q: What if I need changes after launch?
changes.a: You get thirty days of free support after launch — real changes, not just bug fixes. After that, either an optional monthly maintenance plan or pay per change. Your choice. No subscription required.

prepare.q: What do I need to prepare?
prepare.a: Your logo if you have one, a description of your business, and any photos you want to use. If you don't have text written, we'll help. If you don't have a logo, we can make a simple one.

payment.a: Nothing until you've approved the free draft. After that, half to begin the full build and half at launch.

outside.a: Yes — anywhere in Azerbaijan and internationally. Everything is done remotely.

languages.q: Can the site be in more than one language?
languages.a: Yes. Azerbaijani, Russian, and English are all standard for us. Additional languages add a small amount to the price and a couple of days to the timeline.
